extension.description: Understand unfamiliar codebases through bounded, source-backed code flows.
viewContainer.title: Code Flow
view.name: Understand Code
configuration.title: Project Analyzer: Code Flow
configuration.functionNarratives.provide: LLM used only when generating behavior scenarios. Local runs a GGUF model on this computer and releases it after each request; vscode uses a connected VS Code chat model.
configuration.functionNarratives.localBi: Path to llama.cpp's llama-completion executable. Leave empty to use Homebrew or PATH. No server or model runs while idle.
configuration.functionNarratives.localMo: Absolute path to an existing instruction-tuned GGUF model. If empty or missing, the first Analyze all scenarios action automatically downloads Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M (2.74 GB) to the extension cache. Interrupted downloads resume on retry. llama-completion must be preinstalled.
configuration.functionNarratives.sourceD: Show generated LLM scenario/step numbers on their source lines and detailed explanations on hover. Editing the source removes these inference annotations.
configuration.uiLanguage.description: Language for Project Analyzer runtime surfaces. Resolved view and owned editor-panel titles update immediately; Activity Bar container, command/menu, settings, and extension labels follow the VS Code display language after reload.
configuration.uiLanguage.auto: Use Korean only for Korean VS Code display locales; otherwise use English.
configuration.uiLanguage.ko: Use Korean for Project Analyzer runtime surfaces.
configuration.uiLanguage.en: Use English for Project Analyzer runtime surfaces.
configuration.autoAnalyze.description: Analyze the workspace automatically so Code Flow starting points are ready when the view opens.
configuration.include.description: Glob patterns included in project analysis.
configuration.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from project analysis.
configuration.maxFileSizeKb.description: Maximum source file size in KiB for static analysis.
configuration.maxRenderedNodes.descripti: Maximum graph nodes projected and rendered in a single explorer view.
configuration.defaultDepth.description: Default graph expansion depth for caller and callee exploration.
configuration.codeFlow.maxDepth.descript: Maximum downstream call depth shown for a selected-function Code Flow.
configuration.codeFlow.maxSteps.descript: Maximum visible steps in a selected-function Code Flow.
configuration.codeFlow.maxLogicBlocks.de: Maximum syntax-backed statement and expression blocks in a selected Function Logic flow.
configuration.includeExternalDependencie: Include external dependency nodes in graph views.
configuration.showUnresolvedEdges.descri: Show graph edges whose target cannot be resolved statically.
configuration.cache.enabled.description: Persist analysis cache in VS Code workspace storage.
configuration.cache.maxSizeMb.descriptio: Maximum persisted analysis cache size in MiB.
